blocks.text: in / out: ichkariga va tashqariga — va undan ko'proq

Asosiy ma'no tanish: **in** — ichkariga, **out** — tashqariga: come **in**, go **out**, get **in** (→ qizil kitob, 114-dars). Bu darsda ikki yangi narsa bor. Birinchisi — kichik so'z va predlog farqi: **in** / **into**, **out** / **out of**. Ikkinchisi — ko'chma ma'nolar: **in** — biror joyga ro'yxatdan o'tib kirish, guruhga qo'shilish, hujjat topshirish, bosimga yon berish; **out** — rasmiy chiqib ketish va chetda qoldirish. Frazali fe'l turlari va olmosh o'rni — 137-darsda.
in yoki into? Kichik so'z va predlog

**in** va **out** — kichik so'z: ulardan keyin joy aytilmaydi. Joy aytilsa, predlog kerak: **into** (ichiga) va **out of** (ichidan). O'zbekchada bu farq sezilmaydi — «mashinaga o'tirdi» ham, «o'tirib oldi» ham bitta qolip. Inglizchada esa: He **got in**. / He **got into** the car. So'zlashuvda «He got in the car» ham uchraydi, lekin yozuvda **into** ishonchliroq. Predloglar haqida batafsil → 126-dars.

items.text: The door was unlocked, so the police officer **walked** straight **in**.
items.translation: Eshik qulflanmagan ekan, politsiyachi to'g'ri ichkariga **kirib keldi**.

items.text: Bekzod **jumped into** the river to save the little dog.
Somebody **climbed out of** the back window and ran across the garden.
items.translation: Kimdir orqa derazadan **tirmashib chiqdi**-da, bog' bo'ylab yugurib ketdi.

blocks.text: Kirish va chiqish: mehmonxona, uy, bino, sayt

Ko'p in / out juftliklarida **in** — biror joyga rasmiy ravishda «kirish», **out** — undan «chiqish». Mehmonxona va aeroportda **check in** / **check out**, binoda **sign in** / **sign out**, saytda **log in** / **log out**, uyda **move in** / **move out**. Joyni aytmoqchi bo'lsangiz, predlog qo'shiladi: **check in at** the hotel / **check into** the hotel, **move into** a flat, **log in to** your account, **move out of** the house.

rows: yo'q (+ on sb / at a place)

blocks.text: **lock yourself out** — o'zbekchada bunga bitta fe'l yo'q: «kalitni ichkarida qoldirib, eshik ortida qolmoq». **drop in on** + kishi (drop in **on** Aziz), **drop in at** + joy (drop in **at** the office). Britaniyada **pop in** va **call in** ham shu ma'noda ishlatiladi; **look in on** sb — kimdandir xabar olib turmoq.

Ko'chma ma'noda **in** — biror guruh yoki jarayonning **ichiga** kirish: **join in** (boshqalar boshlagan ishga qo'shilmoq), **fit in** (jamoaga moslashmoq), **chip in** (umumiy pulga hissa qo'shmoq). Hujjat yoki ishni «ichkariga» berish — **hand in**, **send in**, **fill in** (bo'sh joylarni to'ldirish). Bosim ostida «ichkariga» yon berish — **give in** (bo'sh kelmoq). **take in** esa uch ma'noli: ma'lumotni **hazm qilmoq** (tushunib olmoq), odamni **aldamoq** (ko'pincha majhul: be taken in), kiyimni **toraytirmoq**.

rows: yo'q yoki bor (join in the fun)
(anketani) to'ldirmoq; **fill in for** sb — o'rnini bosib turmoq

items.text: The kids started a snowball fight, and soon their parents **joined in** too.
items.translation: Bolalar qorbo'ron o'ynashni boshlashdi, ko'p o'tmay ota-onalari ham **qo'shilishdi**.

items.text: We need to **hand in** the final report before the end of the month.
The news was such a shock that it took us days to **take** it **in**.
items.translation: Xabar shunchalik kutilmagan ediki, uni **hazm qilishimizga** bir necha kun kerak bo'ldi.

blocks.text: out: chetda qoldirish va quruq qolish

**out** ning yana bir ma'nosi — biror narsani yoki kishini **tashqarida qoldirish**: **leave out** (tushirib qoldirmoq, qo'shmaslik), **cross out** (chizib tashlamoq), **keep out** (kiritmaslik). Kishining o'zi tashqarida qolsa: **drop out of** (o'qishni, musobaqani tashlab ketmoq), **miss out on** (imkoniyatdan quruq qolmoq), **opt out of** (qatnashmaslikni tanlamoq), **feel left out** (o'zini chetda qolgandek his qilmoq). O'zbekchadagi «tushirib qoldirmoq», «chetda qolmoq», «quruq qolmoq» shu guruhga to'g'ri keladi. **out** ning boshqa ma'nolari — butunlay, tugash, aniqlash — keyingi darsda (→ 139-dars).

items.text: Nobody invited Jasur to the meeting, and he felt **left out**.
items.translation: Hech kim Jasurni yig'ilishga chaqirmadi va u o'zini **chetda qolgandek** his qildi.

items.text: Don't **miss out on** the early-bird discount — it ends on Friday.
items.translation: Erta xarid chegirmasidan **quruq qolmang** — u juma kuni tugaydi.

items.text: You've **left out** the most important part of the story!

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «He entered into the room» → He **went into** the room / He **entered** the room (enter dan keyin predlog yo'q); «Come in the kitchen» → **Come into** the kitchen (joy aytilsa — into); «I closed myself outside» → I **locked myself out**; «Can I join to your game?» → Can I **join in**? / Can I **join** you?; «Fill the form» → **Fill in** the form; «I entered to my account» → I **logged in to** my account; **leave** (ketmoq, qoldirib ketmoq) bilan **leave out** (tushirib qoldirmoq) ni chalkashtirish: I **left** my bag on the bus ≠ You **left out** my name.

in / out juftliklarini bitta gapda, qarama-qarshi qo'yib yodlang: «We **checked in** on Monday and **checked out** on Friday», «They **moved in** in May and **moved out** in July». Joyni qo'shsangiz — **into** / **out of** ni unutmang: move **into** a flat, move **out of** a flat.
Bog'lanish: in / into, to / at — 126-dars; out ning boshqa ma'nolari (run out, find out, work out) — 139-dars; frazali fe'l turlari va olmosh o'rni — 137-dars; asoslar — qizil kitob, 114–115-darslar.

go out, get out, climb out (+ **out of**)

examples.title: Particle or preposition: **get in** / **get into** the car
examples.description: Joy aytilmasa — kichik so'z (**in**, **out**): Get in! Joy aytilsa — predlog (**into**, **out of**): get into the car, climb out of the pool. O'zbekchada ikkalasi ham «-ga kirmoq / -dan chiqmoq».

sentences.text: The taxi's here, so **get in** and put your seatbelt on.
sentences.translation: Taksi keldi, **o'tir** va xavfsizlik kamarini taq.

sentences.text: Aziz **got into** the back of the car and fell asleep at once.
sentences.translation: Aziz mashinaning orqa o'rindig'iga **o'tirdi** va darhol uxlab qoldi.

sentences.text: The office door was open, so I **walked in** without knocking.
sentences.translation: Ofis eshigi ochiq ekan, taqillatmasdan **kirib bordim**.

sentences.text: Sarah **walked into** the meeting room and everybody stopped talking.
sentences.translation: Sara majlis xonasiga **kirib kelishi** bilan hamma jim bo'lib qoldi.

sentences.text: The water looked so inviting that Jasur **dived in** with his clothes on.
sentences.translation: Suv shunchalik jozibali ediki, Jasur kiyimlari bilan **suvga sho'ng'idi**.

sentences.text: Be careful when you **climb out of** the pool — the steps are slippery.
sentences.translation: Hovuzdan **chiqayotganda** ehtiyot bo'ling — zinapoyalar sirpanchiq.

sentences.text: Someone left the gate open, and a stray dog **wandered into** our garden.
sentences.translation: Kimdir darvozani ochiq qoldiribdi, daydi it bog'imizga **adashib kirib qoldi**.

sentences.text: Hurry up and **get out of** bed — the bus leaves in twenty minutes.
sentences.translation: Tez **o'rningdan tur** — avtobus yigirma daqiqadan keyin jo'naydi.

sentences.text: We **squeezed in** at the back of the hall just as the lecture started.
sentences.translation: Ma'ruza boshlanayotganda zalning orqa tomoniga zo'rg'a **sig'ib kirdik**.

sentences.text: When the fire alarm rang, all the staff **hurried out of** the building.
sentences.translation: Yong'in signali chalinganda barcha xodimlar binodan **shoshib chiqib ketishdi**.

examples.title: Hotels, airports and flats: **check in**, **move out**
examples.description: **check in** / **check out** — (mehmonxona, aeroport) ro'yxatdan o'tmoq / xonani topshirib chiqmoq; **move in** / **move out** — ko'chib kelmoq / ko'chib ketmoq; **sign in** / **sign out** — kirishda / chiqishda qayd qildirmoq.

sentences.text: We **checked in** online the night before, so we went straight to security.
sentences.translation: Bir kun oldin onlayn **ro'yxatdan o'tgan edik**, shuning uchun to'g'ri xavfsizlik nazoratiga o'tdik.

sentences.text: Guests must **check out** by eleven, but they can leave their bags at reception.
sentences.translation: Mehmonlar soat o'n birgacha **xonani topshirishi** kerak, lekin sumkalarini qabulxonada qoldirishlari mumkin.

sentences.text: What time did you **check into** the hotel in Bukhara?
sentences.translation: Buxorodagi mehmonxonaga soat nechada **joylashdingiz**?

sentences.text: Our new neighbours **moved in** last week, and they've already invited us for tea.
sentences.translation: Yangi qo'shnilarimiz o'tgan hafta **ko'chib kelishdi** va bizni allaqachon choyga taklif qilishdi.

sentences.text: Madina is **moving out** of her parents' house because she's found a job in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Madina Toshkentdan ish topgani uchun ota-onasining uyidan **ko'chib ketyapti**.

sentences.text: Emma and her boyfriend **moved in** together after two years of dating.
sentences.translation: Emma va yigiti ikki yil uchrashgandan keyin bir uyga **ko'chib o'tishdi**.

sentences.text: All visitors have to **sign in** at the front desk and wear a badge.
sentences.translation: Barcha tashrif buyuruvchilar kiraverishdagi stolda **qayd qildirishi** va nishon taqishi shart.

sentences.text: Don't forget to **sign out** when you leave, or security will think you're still here.
sentences.translation: Ketayotganda **chiqishni qayd qildirishni** unutmang, aks holda qo'riqchilar sizni hali shu yerda deb o'ylashadi.

sentences.text: The previous tenants **moved out** in a hurry and left all their furniture behind.
sentences.translation: Oldingi ijarachilar shoshilib **ko'chib ketishgan** va barcha mebellarini qoldirib ketishgan.

sentences.text: Is it possible to **check out** late? Our flight isn't until ten in the evening.
sentences.translation: Xonani kechroq **topshirsak** bo'ladimi? Reysimiz faqat kechki soat o'nda.

examples.title: Doors and keys: **let in**, **lock out**, **break in**
examples.description: **let in** / **let out** — kiritmoq / chiqarib yubormoq; **lock out** — kalitsiz eshik ortida qoldirmoq; **lock in** — qamab qo'ymoq; **break in** / **break into** — o'g'irlik uchun bostirib kirmoq; **keep out** — kiritmaslik.

sentences.text: I left my keys at work and **locked myself out** of the flat.
sentences.translation: Kalitlarimni ishxonada unutib, kvartira eshigi oldida **qolib ketdim**.

sentences.text: Can you **let** the plumber **in** at ten? I'll be at the dentist's.
sentences.translation: Soat o'nda santexnikni **kiritib yuborasanmi**? Men tish shifokorida bo'laman.

sentences.text: Burglars **broke in** while we were on holiday and took our television.
sentences.translation: Biz ta'tilda bo'lganimizda o'g'rilar uyga **bostirib kirib**, televizorimizni olib ketishdi.

sentences.text: Somebody **broke into** Oliver's car and stole his laptop.
sentences.translation: Kimdir Oliverning mashinasini **buzib ochib**, noutbukini o'g'irlab ketdi.

sentences.text: Please don't **let** the cat **out** — it hasn't had its injections yet.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, mushukni **chiqarib yuborma** — unga hali emlash qilinmagan.

sentences.text: The cleaner didn't see Bekzod and accidentally **locked** him **in** the library.
sentences.translation: Farrosh Bekzodni ko'rmay, uni tasodifan kutubxonada **qamab qo'ydi**.

sentences.text: The farmers built a tall fence to **keep** the wild boars **out**.
sentences.translation: Fermerlar yovvoyi to'ng'izlarni **kiritmaslik** uchun baland to'siq qurishdi.

sentences.text: Who **let** you **in**? The front door is supposed to be locked after nine.
sentences.translation: Seni kim **kiritdi**? Kiraverish eshigi soat to'qqizdan keyin qulflangan bo'lishi kerak-ku.

sentences.text: Open the windows and **let** some fresh air **in** — it's stuffy in here.
sentences.translation: Derazalarni ochib, ozgina toza havo **kiritib yubor** — bu yer dim.

sentences.text: Kate's neighbours heard a noise at night and thought someone was **breaking in**.
sentences.translation: Keytning qo'shnilari kechasi shovqin eshitib, kimdir uyga **bostirib kiryapti** deb o'ylashdi.

examples.title: Visits and evenings: **drop in**, **stay in**, **eat out**
examples.description: **drop in** / **pop in** / **call in** (on sb / at a place) — yo'l-yo'lakay kirib o'tmoq; **look in on** — xabar olib turmoq; **stay in** — uyda qolmoq; **eat in** / **eat out** — shu yerda / tashqarida ovqatlanmoq; **lie in** — ertalab uzoq yotmoq.

sentences.text: If you're ever in Fergana, **drop in** and see us — we'd love that.
sentences.translation: Farg'onaga yo'lingiz tushsa, bizga **kirib o'ting** — juda xursand bo'lamiz.

sentences.text: Nilufar **dropped in on** her aunt on the way home from work.
sentences.translation: Nilufar ishdan qaytayotib xolasinikiga **kirib o'tdi**.

sentences.text: I'll **pop in** to the chemist's for some plasters — it'll only take a minute.
sentences.translation: Leykoplastir olgani dorixonaga **kirib chiqaman** — bir daqiqa vaqt oladi.

sentences.text: Tom **called in** at the office to pick up some documents, then went home.
sentences.translation: Tom ba'zi hujjatlarni olish uchun ofisga **kirib o'tdi**, keyin uyga ketdi.

sentences.text: It's been a long week, so let's **stay in** tonight and watch a film.
sentences.translation: Hafta og'ir o'tdi, bugun kechqurun **uyda qolib**, film ko'raylik.

sentences.text: On Sundays Kate likes to **lie in** until ten and then have a late breakfast.
sentences.translation: Yakshanba kunlari Keyt soat o'ngacha **uzoq yotishni**, keyin kech nonushta qilishni yaxshi ko'radi.

sentences.text: Is that to **eat in** or take away? — Take away, please.
sentences.translation: Shu yerda **yeysizmi** yoki olib ketasizmi? — Olib ketaman.

sentences.text: We hardly ever **eat out** because the restaurants near us are so expensive.
sentences.translation: Yaqinimizdagi restoranlar juda qimmat bo'lgani uchun deyarli hech qachon **tashqarida ovqatlanmaymiz**.

sentences.text: Aziz **called in sick** this morning, so his meeting has been moved to Thursday.
sentences.translation: Aziz bugun ertalab **qo'ng'iroq qilib, kasal ekanini aytdi**, shuning uchun uning uchrashuvi payshanbaga ko'chirildi.

sentences.text: Could you **look in on** Grandma while I'm away? She lives on her own.
sentences.translation: Men yo'qligimda buvimdan **xabar olib turolasanmi**? U yolg'iz yashaydi.

examples.title: Technology and forms: **log in**, **plug in**, **hand in**
examples.description: **log in** / **log out**, **sign in** — tizimga kirmoq / chiqmoq; **type in** — (klaviaturada) kiritmoq; **plug in** — rozetkaga ulamoq; **hand in** / **send in** — topshirmoq / yubormoq; **fill in for sb** — vaqtincha o'rnini bosmoq.

sentences.text: I can't **log in** to my bank account — I think I've forgotten my password.
sentences.translation: Bank hisobimga **kira olmayapman** — parolimni unutganman shekilli.

sentences.text: Always **log out** when you use a computer in a library or an internet café.
sentences.translation: Kutubxona yoki internet-kafeda kompyuterdan foydalansangiz, doim **tizimdan chiqing**.

sentences.text: **Type in** your passport number exactly as it appears on the page.
sentences.translation: Pasport raqamingizni sahifada qanday yozilgan bo'lsa, aynan shunday **kiriting**.

sentences.text: My laptop died in the middle of the lecture because I forgot to **plug** it **in**.
sentences.translation: Noutbukimni rozetkaga **ulashni** unutganim uchun u ma'ruza o'rtasida o'chib qoldi.

sentences.text: Before you see the doctor, please **fill in** this short form about your health.
sentences.translation: Shifokor qabuliga kirishdan oldin, iltimos, sog'lig'ingiz haqidagi ushbu qisqa anketani **to'ldiring**.

sentences.text: Can you **fill in for** me on Friday? I've got a hospital appointment.
sentences.translation: Juma kuni mening **o'rnimga ishlab tura olasanmi**? Kasalxonada qabulim bor.

sentences.text: More than three hundred people **sent in** photos for the competition.
sentences.translation: Tanlovga uch yuzdan ortiq kishi surat **yubordi**.

sentences.text: Jasur **handed in** his notice yesterday — he's starting a new job in Dubai.
sentences.translation: Jasur kecha **ishdan bo'shash haqida ariza berdi** — Dubayda yangi ish boshlayapti.

sentences.text: To use the Wi-Fi, just **sign in** with your room number and surname.
sentences.translation: Wi-Fi dan foydalanish uchun xona raqamingiz va familiyangiz bilan **tizimga kiring**.

sentences.text: Has everyone **handed in** their essays? — Not yet, two students are still writing.
sentences.translation: Hamma inshosini **topshirdimi**? — Hali yo'q, ikki talaba hali yozyapti.

examples.title: Taking part: **join in**, **fit in**, **give in**
examples.description: **join in** — (boshqalar boshlagan ishga) qo'shilmoq; **fit in** — jamoaga moslashmoq; **give in** (to) — bo'sh kelmoq; **take in** — hazm qilmoq / aldamoq / toraytirmoq; **chip in** — umumiy pulga qo'shmoq.

sentences.text: Everyone was singing, so Dilnoza **joined in**, even though she didn't know the words.
sentences.translation: Hamma qo'shiq aytayotgan edi, Dilnoza so'zlarini bilmasa ham **qo'shilib ketdi**.

sentences.text: Please feel free to **join in** the discussion at any time.
sentences.translation: Istalgan vaqtda muhokamaga bemalol **qo'shilavering**.

sentences.text: James found it hard to **fit in** at his new school in Edinburgh.
sentences.translation: Jeyms Edinburgdagi yangi maktabiga **moslashishga** qiynaldi.

sentences.text: Our new colleague **fitted in** perfectly from the very first day.
sentences.translation: Yangi hamkasbimiz birinchi kundanoq jamoaga mutlaqo **moslashib ketdi**.

sentences.text: The boy cried for an ice cream until his mother finally **gave in**.
sentences.translation: Bola muzqaymoq so'rab yig'ladi, oxiri onasi **bo'sh keldi**.

sentences.text: The workers refused to **give in to** the company's demands.
sentences.translation: Ishchilar kompaniyaning talablariga **bo'ysunishdan** bosh tortishdi.

sentences.text: There was so much information that I couldn't **take** it all **in**.
sentences.translation: Ma'lumot shunchalik ko'p ediki, hammasini **hazm qila olmadim**.

sentences.text: Don't be **taken in** by emails that promise you easy money.
sentences.translation: Oson pul va'da qiladigan xatlarga **aldanib qolmang**.

sentences.text: Since Madina lost weight, she's had to **take in** all her dresses.
sentences.translation: Madina ozganidan beri barcha ko'ylaklarini **toraytirishga** to'g'ri keldi.

sentences.text: We all **chipped in** to buy our teacher a farewell present.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchimizga xayrlashuv sovg'asi olish uchun hammamiz **pul qo'shdik**.

examples.title: Left out: **leave out**, **drop out**, **miss out**
examples.description: **out** — chetda qoldirish: **leave out** — tushirib qoldirmoq; **cross out** — chizib tashlamoq; **drop out (of)** — tashlab ketmoq; **miss out (on)** — quruq qolmoq; **opt out (of)** — qatnashmaslikni tanlamoq; **feel left out** — o'zini chetda qolgandek his qilmoq.

sentences.text: You've **left out** an important detail: when exactly did the accident happen?
sentences.translation: Muhim bir tafsilotni **tushirib qoldirdingiz**: avariya aynan qachon sodir bo'ldi?

sentences.text: The coach **left** Bekzod **out** of the team because of his injury.
sentences.translation: Murabbiy jarohati tufayli Bekzodni jamoaga **kiritmadi**.

sentences.text: Nobody spoke to Emma at the party, and she felt completely **left out**.
sentences.translation: Ziyofatda hech kim Emma bilan gaplashmadi, u o'zini butunlay **chetda qolgandek** his qildi.

sentences.text: If you make a mistake on the form, don't **cross** it **out** — ask for a new one.
sentences.translation: Anketada xato qilsangiz, uni **chizib tashlamang** — yangisini so'rang.

sentences.text: Oliver **dropped out of** university in his second year to start his own company.
sentences.translation: Oliver o'z kompaniyasini ochish uchun ikkinchi kursda universitetni **tashlab ketdi**.

sentences.text: Two runners **dropped out** of the race because of the heat.
sentences.translation: Jazirama tufayli ikki yuguruvchi musobaqadan **chiqib ketdi**.

sentences.text: Book your tickets early, or you'll **miss out on** the best seats.
sentences.translation: Chiptalarni oldinroq bron qiling, aks holda eng yaxshi joylardan **quruq qolasiz**.

sentences.text: Jasur was ill during the school trip and felt he had **missed out**.
sentences.translation: Jasur maktab sayohati paytida kasal bo'lib qoldi va o'zini **quruq qolgandek** his qildi.

sentences.text: Employees can **opt out of** the pension scheme, but most people stay in it.
sentences.translation: Xodimlar pensiya dasturidan **chiqishi** mumkin, lekin ko'pchilik qoladi.

sentences.text: When you write the report, **leave out** names so that nobody can be identified.
sentences.translation: Hisobotni yozganingizda, hech kimni tanib bo'lmasligi uchun ismlarni **tushirib qoldiring**.

examples.title: Dialogue: moving into a student flat
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: talabalar kvartirasiga ko'chib kelgan qiz va qo'shnisi — move in, get in, let in, fill in, hand in, log in, join in, fit in, lock out, drop in.

sentences.text: — Hi, I'm Kate. Are you the new girl who's **moving in** today?
sentences.translation: — Salom, men Keytman. Bugun **ko'chib kelayotgan** yangi qiz sizmisiz?

sentences.text: — Yes, I'm Nilufar. Sorry, I couldn't **get in** — the door code didn't work.
sentences.translation: — Ha, men Nilufarman. Kechirasiz, **kira olmadim** — eshik kodi ishlamadi.

sentences.text: — Don't worry, I'll **let** you **in**. Here, give me one of those bags.
sentences.translation: — Xavotir olmang, men sizni **kiritaman**. Mana, sumkalardan birini bering.

sentences.text: — Thanks! Do I need to **fill in** any forms for the landlord?
sentences.translation: — Rahmat! Uy egasi uchun biror anketa **to'ldirishim** kerakmi?

sentences.text: — Just one, and you can **hand** it **in** at the office downstairs.
sentences.translation: — Faqat bitta, uni pastdagi ofisga **topshirsangiz** bo'ladi.

sentences.text: — Great. And what's the Wi-Fi password? I need to **log in** for my classes.
sentences.translation: — Zo'r. Wi-Fi paroli qanaqa? Darslarim uchun **tizimga kirishim** kerak.

sentences.text: — It's on the fridge. We're having a small party on Friday — **join in** if you like!
sentences.translation: — Muzlatgichda yozilgan. Juma kuni kichik ziyofat qilyapmiz — xohlasangiz **qo'shiling**!

sentences.text: — I'd love to. I was worried that I wouldn't **fit in** here.
sentences.translation: — Jon deb. Bu yerga **moslasha olmayman** deb xavotirda edim.

sentences.text: — Don't be silly. Oh, and never **lock yourself out** — a spare key costs fifty pounds!
sentences.translation: — Qo'ysangiz-chi. Ha, aytgancha, hech qachon kalitsiz **eshik ortida qolmang** — zaxira kalit ellik funt turadi!

sentences.text: — Noted! I'll **drop in** on you later once I've unpacked.
sentences.translation: — Esda tutaman! Narsalarimni joylab bo'lgach, keyinroq sizga **kirib o'taman**.
